timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Why do we need to secure infrastructure as code?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Because IaC deploys at scale. One misconfiguration template can compromise an entire environment.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Can't we just review the templates manually?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: You can review one. Now try reviewing 500 lines of ARM JSON without a tool. Good luck.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Tools like Checkov and Defender for Cloud scan your templates for misconfigurations automatically.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Open storage accounts, unrestricted network rules, missing encryption, overprivileged identities. The classics.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Azure Policy that runs before deployment. If your template violates a policy, it gets rejected. No exceptions.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Someone manually changes a resource in the portal. Drift detection catches the gap between your template and reality.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So IaC security is basically guardrails for your cloud?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Exactly. Automated guardrails that scale with your infrastructure.
